name: Deep Princess III
source:
One year after the fall of the holy city of Elk the world has become a huge livestock reproductive farm managed by monsters. But even in this desperate situation princess knight keeps fighting for her country independence. She released numerous slaves, but her luck did not last long and she got into a trap. She is at beasts' mercy now.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-february-2007-utsurigi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
圣城麋鹿陷落一年后，世界变成了一个由怪物管理的巨大牲畜繁殖场。但即使在这种绝望的情况下，骑士公主仍继续为国家独立而奋斗。她释放了无数奴隶，但好运没有持续多久，她就陷入了陷阱。她现在正受到野兽的摆布。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-february-2007-utsurigi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
